project.name: osgi/doctor/doctor-port
project.description: The doctor observation port — the seam the diagnostic model depends on and the host implements (DIP). Pure POJO model: the SnapshotSource interface and the pure exchange records (SnapshotEntry, SnapshotView) that replace the host StackSnapshot/StackHistory at the boundary, plus the port's failure-mode exceptions. Zero pulumi, zero osgi runtime — host-loaded and system-exported at runtime so both worlds share one copy. Per-package @Version (starts 1.0.0).
